content: Be pirǝ azaa ondo o kala o gongha
Awere name na atoma Yeso ne deya akai, nane pirkǝ na, “Mana kala o gongha a nyimi togomo te zaa shili?”
Naka rare kena ka baate ka yende, naka eke kai baa tera one,
aka bekaa na, “Eyang dongdong bele oying, eeta kurǝ ka e itǝ naa abana ayana aana ne, eto lyǝ ba togomo ta zaa shili ne.
Pate ondooka wa jipǝrǝ ukpwei wai naa ka bana kena kaana, waya wa kala o gongha a togomo te zaa shili.
Pate ondooka wa kabare ka kabana kena naa kaana, mia wa embang.”
Mapapa ma o ote o cǝwǝ
Pate ka nyimi, ondooka wa ote kena ka yende ba nyimi abana ayana aaka ne kabare kaa mi ka ka ye madinǝ, wayo kala aa tere wai onyanto aa lengmelo, a tare wai ba nyimi o pong o gerpo.”
Ee lyǝ udi lerambo, aza epa eeka e oteze aromo kane ye madinǝ! Dongdong ngha ebelo epaana eye, pate ka nyimi ondo ote ka a cǝwǝ, wa lyǝ udi.

Aa o ara o, na obona o, wa ote ka o lyǝ a madinǝ, mara o core wa ka opere. Wa kala o lyǝ ara e ebeene o dera o maro kaa o ara yende, na obona yende, na ka legǝdǝ, koo bena tareo ola kaa wata lumbuzu ne ka tobona to leere, ka taara te leere teo a pate.
Kangza Liizi leo le otezeo ko lyǝ a madinǝ lopa le ka o pere. Wa gwara o lyǝ ara ebene o dera o maro ka liizi le yende, ka o bena o ale akwilǝ ola ka yizi leere.”
A ngmǝ aa gerpo azaa o mande openg kawa wilǝ
“Ekena toto, tane zeele kena ka yende baa nyimia ayana na ne. Eyang belo ying, atoma ane o dera apung o nyimia shili ne gonte mainu ma Ate ang omea waya nyimia shili konang were.
Obena Kena ka Oromo ka deya ka ka boze andaaka ne wilǝ.
“Eya madoola maying? Ondo waya ka emande lewinu, na kayende ka wilǝ, wato baya etuuru torai ka o torai name aa ting oyara aa wa ale ba gera ka yende kanname sang?
Wa cǝ kai, eyang dongdong bele oying, wayo kona oleba maleo o kala etuuru torai ka otorai eeka eta e wilǝ ne.
Nyimia, Ate oying azaa shili wato kona oleba a kena ka yende ba nyimi ayana na ka wili ne.”
Orone ka wa tambo
“Aa orone o wa yau tambo bo, o ale ka o bele wai epaaka wa yau, ying ngha leere belle. Wa kona epaaka ba bele wai, baa kuriyǝ orone o orona naname.
Waata konau ne, o ale ka oromo yende na a leere kane laka aane kone, adorana angmǝ me itǝ ka ma ganggang a begeshe be aromo leere, na a taaro.
Wa nyana kona one, o bele akwilǝ ana o tare Ashili, kangza waata kona nee ne, o kuriyǝ wai a nyimi andaaka neta rosa Ashili ne na ondo eesa emate o makeke.”
“Eyang dongdong bele oying, pate epaaka e tera a lerambo leena, awa itǝ epaaka a samba o tera me ba zaa shili. Pate epaaka e dinggǝ a lerambo leena, eyo itǝ ka o dinggǝ a zaa shili.
“Eyang dongdong wala o bele oying na, aromo leere ba nyimi lerambo leena ne kabare ka tukpwei tone ba za epaaka neya bosa me, Ate ang omea waya nyimia zaa shili wayo nya ne.
Pate araaka aromo leere, na a taaro ne gwarnang ba nyimi leze leng, eyang cikǝ legwa kaa ne.”
Ozara ooka wata pisǝzǝ epa eeka ya wa ne
Na Biturusu paka ting Yeso nawa pirkǝ na, “Ateokora, ka wondaa orone ong wa tambo a mi ang pisi wai? Ka o sondaare na?”
Na Yeso bekaa na, “Ka o sondaare belle dai, ka o sondaarea o dukǝa etuuru sondaare.
“Aza nyimi ayo kedeya togomo te a zaa shili ka ogomo omea waya yeme o eza abalo ocǝ wai ka eeya taara te azara wai.
Nangka wa bore obala ocǝ wai me, naa de ka ondo omea ogomo me tare wai emate magu betuuru.
O bena wato ama o ara me ne, na ateakwilǝ wai wa ote ka a lishi wai ka ondaye wai ka ayana wai ka pate magogoro ma wai, ka a are uduru me.
Na ozara me tunggunu a begeshe be wai a wa bose wai na, “Ateakwilǝ tana o mungi ne, eyang arau ba pat.”
A aza obena ateakwilǝ me wa kone egonegone ozara me, nawa baya a wai kaa uduru me.
“Nangka ozara me wa ere arakaname, ka o surǝ wai nawa laka oja lezara awai, ka wa tare wai uduru o kap, emate lewinu. Nawa moke lengmelo le wai, a wa beka wai na, “Arang pate epaaka ang taroo.”
Na oja lezara me bose wai naa tana wa mungi ne eyang arau.”
Na ozara me ta kabare ne, nyimia na wa ale ka wai na pate wai akwilǝ andaleme, seena wa are emate uduru me.
Nangka aja lezara le wai ne kone epaaka eya ale, neta ne kone oleba nyimi ne. Nane ale ba ateakwilǝ one nane bele wai epaaka ozara name wa ya.
Na ateakwilǝ me wa rare wai, nawa beka wai na, “Bo ozara oburua wai. Ma bayau ka uduru ooka ang taro aza obena ba de na obosheng,
wa ta gwara o kone egonegone o beja be lezara lo nangka maa kona egonegone o sang?”
Na ateakwilǝ wai wa mungi ka wai, aa wa ote na a gǝǝzǝ wai, aa wa ote wai na wa are pate epaaka a tare wai.
Nyimia kangza Ate ang o nyimia zaa shili wayo ya kaa komana o ying, eeta pisǝ andaa ying kaa lenyong le yende ne.”
